benefits: The platform provides a platform for women entrepreneurs to connect with each other and with other stakeholders in the ecosystem.
The platform provides training, mentorship, and access to finance for women entrepreneurs.
schemes.description: The Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP) is an initiative of the NITI Aayog to promote entrepreneurship among women. The platform provides a platform for women entrepreneurs to connect with each other and with other stakeholders in the ecosystem. The WEP also provides training, mentorship, and access to finance for women entrepreneurs. The WEP was launched in 2018 and is being implemented by the NITI Aayog.
eligibility: The applicant should be a woman entrepreneur.
The applicant should have a good credit score.
schemes.financial_benefits: The platform provides access to finance for women entrepreneurs.

steps: Visit the official website of the WEP.
Fill in the online registration form.

rejection_reasons: The applicant is not a woman entrepreneur.
The applicant has a bad credit score.

schemes.description: The Mahila E-Haat is an online platform launched by the Ministry of Women and Child Development to promote entrepreneurship among women. The platform provides a platform for women entrepreneurs to sell their products and services online.
